review.reason: Exact runtime member/xref ownership and defining stores establish private stream lifetimes. Both original formatter executions overwrite all ten bytes before reading them; different-stack-depth and stale-pointer/capacity poisoning preserve output. Only stack-local cursor displacement is abstracted, retaining advancement and remaining capacity. Raw differences remain in the ledger.

limitations: Applies only to these two CRT private stream records and stack-resident output buffers.
Does not abstract other pointers, output bytes, output advancement, remaining capacity, public state, or escaped addresses.
